history.name: Renaming a feature
history.description: The command ledger rename changes what a feature is called, and every document footnotes the name it went by before. A feature that existed before this release needs a reason: one bullet saying what it was called and why the name moved.
history.dev_notes: src/commands/write.mjs cmdRename. The old name comes from Feature#stateAt's renamedFrom, computed from the named entries in the history rather than stored.
